documents.title: Batch/Lot Tracking on the Operations Grid
documents.description: How Batch, Batch Qty and Expiry Date work across Indent, Inventory, Purchase and Sales — one shared screen, four business flows, and only one place a brand-new batch is ever minted.

documents.title: Employee Attribution — User-to-Employee Activity Logs
